statement: A fix to a prospective rubric was checked for no rise only against the old rubric, so it could not see itself raising the new rubric back toward the old one: a whole-file matrix refusal let an unrelated job's fromJSON matrix keep an ungated publish counted, lifting the new rubric's score to exactly the old rubric's. Rules: when a candidate rubric is revised, compare each fixture with the candidate's own previous revision too, pinned from that commit; and list every permitted rise by name, so a new one fails.

After a squash merge dropped two commits a changelog cited, the citation check went red on main, and the errata register could not repair it: its lost-in-squash entry clears only a citation that resolves to nothing, while GitHub still holds the dropped commits under the pull request's head, where they are unreachable commits that only an evidence tag clears. Rules: merge any pull request whose records cite its own commits with a merge commit; when one is squashed, the repair is an evidence tag, an operator action.
